_meta.name: Listing Health & Seller Re-alignment
_meta.description: Identifies stale listings, analyzes showing feedback and comp data, drafts consultative price strategy emails for sellers.

nodes.name: Pull Listing Data
nodes.description: Fetch active listings, days on market, showing feedback, and recent comparable sales

nodes.name: Identify Stale Listings & Recommend Strategy
nodes.description: Score each listing by staleness risk, identify price-vs-market gaps, recommend action

nodes.name: Draft Seller Communications
nodes.description: Write empathetic, data-backed strategy emails to sellers with specific comp references

nodes.name: Verify Drafts — Fair Housing & Factual Check
nodes.description: Enforce Fair Housing Act compliance, verify all comp data is accurate, reject discriminatory language

nodes.name: Queue for Broker Review
nodes.description: Log all approved drafts to email queue for broker approval before sending

nodes.name: Update Listing Patterns
nodes.description: Store listing health patterns, price reduction signals, and market timing data
